title: Trial Against INtractable Type 2 Diabetes (CAPTAIN-T2D)
official: Clofutriben And Placebo Phase 2 Trial Against INtractable Type 2 Diabetes (CAPTAIN-T2D)
summary: CAPTAIN-T2D will take place in two parts. Part 1 (Screening) will evaluate patients with type 2 diabetes and elevated cortisol risk factors for trial eligibility and the presence of elevated cortisol. Participants deemed eligible from Part 1 will be randomized to either clofutriben or placebo in the double-blind (participant and investigator), dose-ranging, interventional Part 2 (Treatment).
